name: natural_fading
description: Default. Walks back from the latest prompt: 2 verbatim turns, then 5 turn-summaries, then the session summary, the project summary, and recent decisions, capped with a session-agnostic relevance sweep. Mimics how a person remembers a conversation — sharp at the top, fading into gist as it gets older — while keeping total recall reachable through the L3/L4 layers and surfacing relevant material from anywhere in the corpus via general_search.
